no_adcom_quote.quote: Efficacy and safety issues identified in the application did not rise to the level of requiring the input from an advisory panel. Therefore, no advisory committee was convened.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for MACRILEN (NDA205598). The FDA Summary Review states that the efficacy and safety issues identified in the application did not rise to the level of requiring input from an advisory panel, and the Medical Review confirms there was no Advisory Committee meeting for this application. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
